directive: 通知の発生状況と話者を踏まえ、必要な情報を簡潔に伝える。変数を保つ。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: That's quite possible. We have probably wasted a whole battalion by now.
entries.JA_current: That's quite possible. We have probably wasted a whole battalion by now.
entries.JA_new: そうかもしれないな。もう大隊一つ分を無駄にした頃だ。

entries.EN: We should wait for some stalkers to get back from deep raids in the Zone - maybe they have heard some news about all this.
entries.JA_current: We should wait for some stalkers to get back from deep raids in the Zone - maybe they have heard some news about all this.
entries.JA_new: ゾーンの奥へ遠征に出たストーカーが戻るのを待とう。何か聞いているかもしれない。

entries.EN: Maybe they have. Still, I've got some useful info. I have it on good authority that "Freedom" had some common business with the Military lately.
entries.JA_current: Maybe they have. Still, I've got some useful info. I have it on good authority that "Freedom" had some common business with the Military lately.
entries.JA_new: そうかもな。だが、役に立つ情報をつかんだ。信頼できる筋から聞いたんだが、最近フリーダムはミリタリーと何か取引をしていたらしい。

entries.EN: Bullshit! Freedom and the Military, cooperating!? No way!
entries.JA_current: Bullshit! Freedom and the Military, cooperating!? No way!
entries.JA_new: 嘘だろ！　フリーダムとミリタリーが協力してるって？　あり得ない！

entries.EN: You'd better believe it. A stalker known as "Outrage" has helped them get into the X-16 lab, and maybe with other things as well.
entries.JA_current: You'd better believe it. A stalker known as "Outrage" has helped them get into the X-16 lab, and maybe with other things as well.
entries.JA_new: 信じたほうがいい。アウトレイジってストーカーが、奴らをX-16研究所に案内したらしい。他にも手を貸しているかもしれない。

entries.EN: Damn, that's just what we needed... Together, the Freedom guys and the Military will smear us off the map like swatting a fly. We'd be caught off guard, about as helpless as a litter of blind kittens... Fuck!
entries.JA_current: Damn, that's just what we needed... Together, the Freedom guys and the Military will smear us off the map like swatting a fly. We'd be caught off guard, about as helpless as a litter of blind kittens... Fuck!
entries.JA_new: くそ、最悪の事態だ……フリーダムとミリタリーが組んだら、ハエを叩き潰すみたいに俺たちを消し飛ばすぞ。何も知らず、目の見えない子犬みたいに無防備なままな……くそっ！

entries.EN: "Us"? You are just a barkeep! I doubt anyone will go after you.
entries.JA_current: "Us"? You are just a barkeep! I doubt anyone will go after you.
entries.JA_new: 「俺たち」って？　あんたはただのバーキープだろ。誰もあんたを狙わないさ。

entries.EN: Are you telling me to escape, to flee like a cowardly bandit?! Over my dead body! I'm not giving up my bar! I helped take this place from the bastard mutants, cleared it, built it up from nothing, this bar means everything to me!
entries.JA_current: Are you telling me to escape, to flee like a cowardly bandit?! Over my dead body! I'm not giving up my bar! I helped take this place from the bastard mutants, cleared it, built it up from nothing, this bar means everything to me!
entries.JA_new: 逃げろって言うのか？　臆病なバンディットみたいに尻尾を巻いて？　死んでもごめんだ！　バーは渡さない。ミュータントどもから奪い返し、掃除して、一から作り上げた。ここは俺のすべてなんだ！

entries.EN: Wow, are the profits that good, huh? He-he... Ok, let's cut the chatter, time's running out. I'm going to see Lukash to dig for some info about all this.
entries.JA_current: Wow, are the profits that good, huh? He-he... Ok, let's cut the chatter, time's running out. I'm going to see Lukash to dig for some info about all this.
entries.JA_new: へえ、そんなに儲かるのか？　はは……おしゃべりはここまでだ。時間がない。ルカシュに会って、話を探ってくる。

entries.EN: Haa, as if he'd actually tell you anything, like hell he would! You're better off speaking to our scout over there, he's always been our go to guy for intel about Freedom's activities. In the past he's managed to dig up some pretty good stuff, maybe he has a way into their base or something, who knows. Either way, he's your man, he can point you in the right direction, give you tips on how to get the info we need. If these bastards are really joining forces with the grunts, he will certainly be able to help.
entries.JA_current: Haa, as if he'd actually tell you anything, like hell he would! You're better off speaking to our scout over there, he's always been our go to guy for intel about Freedom's activities. In the past he's managed to dig up some pretty good stuff, maybe he has a way into their base or something, who knows. Either way, he's your man, he can point you in the right direction, give you tips on how to get the info we need. If these bastards are really joining forces with the grunts, he will certainly be able to help.
entries.JA_new: はあ、あいつがお前に話すわけないだろ！　向こうの偵察兵に聞いてみろ。フリーダムの動きを探る時は、いつも頼りにしてる奴だ。今までもいい情報を引き出してきた。基地への入り方を知ってるかもしれない。とにかく、あいつなら道筋を教えて、必要な情報の集め方も助言してくれる。フリーダムが本当に兵隊どもと手を組んでるなら、きっと力になってくれる。

entries.EN: Frankly speaking, I don't care one bit about your showdown with the Army. I'm after "Outrage"... But, when I get him, I'll be sure to make him spill the beans on everything he's been up to.
entries.JA_current: Frankly speaking, I don't care one bit about your showdown with the Army. I'm after "Outrage"... But, when I get him, I'll be sure to make him spill the beans on everything he's been up to.
entries.JA_new: 正直、軍との対決には興味がない。狙いはアウトレイジだ……捕まえたら、何を企んでいたのか全部吐かせてやる。

entries.EN: What are you chasing him for?
entries.JA_current: What are you chasing him for?
entries.JA_new: どうしてあいつを追ってる？

entries.EN: On private business.
entries.JA_current: On private business.
entries.JA_new: 個人的な用事だ。

entries.EN: Fair enough... Well, it's your affair, I'm not gonna pry. Just try to dig up this link between the the jarheads and Freedom, alright? Sock him one for me if you catch up to him!
entries.JA_current: Fair enough... Well, it's your affair, I'm not gonna pry. Just try to dig up this link between the the jarheads and Freedom, alright? Sock him one for me if you catch up to him!
entries.JA_new: そうか……まあ、お前の用事なら詮索はしない。だが、軍人どもとフリーダムのつながりを調べてくれ。あいつに会ったら、俺の代わりに一発ぶん殴ってやれ！

entries.EN: It's a deal. How do I find that scout of yours?
entries.JA_current: It's a deal. How do I find that scout of yours?
entries.JA_new: 分かった。あんたの偵察兵はどこにいる？

entries.EN: He must be in the vicinity of the village to the south-west of the warehouses. Duty has got a campsite and observation post set up there... Didn't you know?
entries.JA_current: He must be in the vicinity of the village to the south-west of the warehouses. Duty has got a campsite and observation post set up there... Didn't you know?
entries.JA_new: 軍事倉庫の南西にある村の近くだ。デューティーが野営地と監視所を設けている。知らなかったか？

entries.EN: I do now. Thanks for the info!
entries.JA_current: I do now. Thanks for the info!
entries.JA_new: 今知ったよ。情報ありがとう！

entries.EN: Look, Barkeep. May I deposit some of my belongings at your bar?
entries.JA_current: Look, Barkeep. May I deposit some of my belongings at your bar?
entries.JA_new: なあ、バーキープ。荷物をいくつか、バーに預けてもいいか？

entries.EN: What, ran out of stashes in the Zone? You really think I'm the safer option?
entries.JA_current: What, ran out of stashes in the Zone? You really think I'm the safer option?
entries.JA_new: ゾーンに隠し場所がなくなったのか？　本当に俺のほうが安全だと思ってる？

entries.EN: Sure you are.
entries.JA_current: Sure you are.
entries.JA_new: ああ、そうだ。

entries.EN: Well, you are welcome to deposit whatever you want, it won't get messed with over here. But it's gonna cost you, I'm gonna need a bit of a kickback as a fee for my services, you see. We're talking somewhere in the range of a couple grand, perhaps?
entries.JA_current: Well, you are welcome to deposit whatever you want, it won't get messed with over here. But it's gonna cost you, I'm gonna need a bit of a kickback as a fee for my services, you see. We're talking somewhere in the range of a couple grand, perhaps?
entries.JA_new: 何でも預けていいぞ。ここなら誰にも手を出させない。ただし、タダじゃない。預かり賃を少しもらう。二千ルーブルくらいでどうだ？

entries.EN: Here's 3 grand, and I hope nothing is missing when I return for it! One other thing: some scientist may come in here looking for me at some point. If he says the password "znoy", he's a friend of mine - message my PDA as soon as possible. That's very important to me.
entries.JA_current: Here's 3 grand, and I hope nothing is missing when I return for it! One other thing: some scientist may come in here looking for me at some point. If he says the password "znoy", he's a friend of mine - message my PDA as soon as possible. That's very important to me.
entries.JA_new: 三千ルーブルだ。戻ってきた時に一つも欠けてないといいが！　それと、いつか科学者が俺を訪ねてくるかもしれない。「ズノイ」という合言葉を言ったら、俺の友人だ。すぐに俺のPDAへ知らせてくれ。大事なことなんだ。

entries.EN: Sure, I'll keep my eyes open and my ears sharp. Why not help a good guy like you, right? I'll let you know by all means if anything turns up.
entries.JA_current: Sure, I'll keep my eyes open and my ears sharp. Why not help a good guy like you, right? I'll let you know by all means if anything turns up.
entries.JA_new: 分かった。目も耳も利かせておくよ。お前みたいないい奴を助けない理由はないからな。何かあれば必ず知らせる。

entries.EN: Oh, you want to charge me? I thought we were friends... If that's how it's gonna be, I'm not depositing anything. Screw being ripped off!
entries.JA_current: Oh, you want to charge me? I thought we were friends... If that's how it's gonna be, I'm not depositing anything. Screw being ripped off!
entries.JA_new: 金を取るのか？　友達だと思ってたのに……そういうことなら、何も預けない。ぼったくられるのはごめんだ！

entries.EN: It's good you're still here! Take a look at these documents.
entries.JA_current: It's good you're still here! Take a look at these documents.
entries.JA_new: まだここにいてくれてよかった！　この書類を見てくれ。

entries.EN: I have something to tell you!
entries.JA_current: I have something to tell you!
entries.JA_new: 話があるんです！

entries.EN: First - the documents!
entries.JA_current: First - the documents!
entries.JA_new: まずは書類を見てくれ！

entries.EN: Alright, alright, as you wish. So... Well... That's what colonel Musorenko was intending to sell... Hm, the "million dollar question"...
entries.JA_current: Alright, alright, as you wish. So... Well... That's what colonel Musorenko was intending to sell... Hm, the "million dollar question"...
entries.JA_new: 分かった、分かった。君の言うとおりにしよう。これは……ムソレンコ大佐が売ろうとしていたものか……なるほど、「核心の質問」だな……

entries.EN: This is a virus, some type of biological weapon, and I am infected with it. I need a vaccine, or a cure, treatment, anything.
entries.JA_current: This is a virus, some type of biological weapon, and I am infected with it. I need a vaccine, or a cure, treatment, anything.
entries.JA_new: これはウイルスです。生物兵器の一種で、僕は感染している。ワクチンでも、治療薬でも、何でもいい。とにかく治療法が必要なんです。

entries.EN: There may be a problem here. The virus was tested on humans in the eighties, but the project seems to have been closed soon after that. It is said...
entries.JA_current: There may be a problem here. The virus was tested on humans in the eighties, but the project seems to have been closed soon after that. It is said...
entries.JA_new: 問題がありそうです。このウイルスは1980年代に人体実験されましたが、計画はそのすぐ後に打ち切られたようです。記録によれば……

entries.EN: Let's get down to brass tacks. Did you get anything out of these papers?
entries.JA_current: Let's get down to brass tacks. Did you get anything out of these papers?
entries.JA_new: 本題に入ろう。この書類から何か分かったのか？

entries.EN: Yes, yes, certainly. "ZNOY-13" is a mutated HIV virus intended for combat use.
entries.JA_current: Yes, yes, certainly. "ZNOY-13" is a mutated HIV virus intended for combat use.
entries.JA_new: ええ、もちろん。「ZNOY-13」は戦闘利用を目的とした変異型HIVウイルスです。

entries.EN: Pardon me?
entries.JA_current: Pardon me?
entries.JA_new: 何だって？

entries.EN: You mean I'm doomed, don't you?
entries.JA_current: You mean I'm doomed, don't you?
entries.JA_new: つまり、僕はもう助からないんですね？

entries.EN: Wait! Please! The thing is... Ahh, some armored brutes came in here after you had gone, armed to the teeth, and... Well, they knew about the project and the money. All this feels like a damn nightmare... They threatened to kill me, to break my legs if...
entries.JA_current: Wait! Please! The thing is... Ahh, some armored brutes came in here after you had gone, armed to the teeth, and... Well, they knew about the project and the money. All this feels like a damn nightmare... They threatened to kill me, to break my legs if...
entries.JA_new: 待ってください！　実は……あなたが去った後、装甲服を着た屈強な連中がここへ来たんです。武装も完全で……計画と金のことを知っていました。悪夢みたいです……奴らは、話さなければ殺す、足を折ると脅してきて……

entries.EN: What did they look like?? Focus, man, spit it out!
entries.JA_current: What did they look like?? Focus, man, spit it out!
entries.JA_new: どんな奴らだった？　しっかりしろ、早く話せ！

entries.EN: They were dressed in camouflaged uniform, I'm not familiar with the design patterns. They spoke about setting an ambush... here, in the catacombs. I think they're planning to kill you!
entries.JA_current: They were dressed in camouflaged uniform, I'm not familiar with the design patterns. They spoke about setting an ambush... here, in the catacombs. I think they're planning to kill you!
entries.JA_new: 迷彩服を着ていましたが、見慣れない柄でした。待ち伏せをすると話していて……ここ、地下墓所でです。あなたを殺すつもりだと思います！

entries.EN: Huh, we'll see, perhaps it'll be them feeding worms before the day's over.
entries.JA_current: Huh, we'll see, perhaps it'll be them feeding worms before the day's over.
entries.JA_new: そうか。日が暮れる前に、あいつらがミミズの餌になってるかもしれないな。

entries.EN: And what about me?
entries.JA_current: And what about me?
entries.JA_new: それで、私はどうすれば？

entries.EN: Get out of here and head to your comrades. Tell them that some zombies attacked you in X-18 and overran your positions, killing everyone, but you managed to slip away. Play the fool, make something up, I don't care.
entries.JA_current: Get out of here and head to your comrades. Tell them that some zombies attacked you in X-18 and overran your positions, killing everyone, but you managed to slip away. Play the fool, make something up, I don't care.
entries.JA_new: ここを出て仲間のところへ戻れ。X-18でゾンビに襲われ、陣地を突破されて全員殺されたが、お前だけは何とか逃げ延びたと伝えろ。馬鹿のふりでも、適当な話でもいい。とにかくそう言え。

entries.EN: Alright, I got it. I get it...
entries.JA_current: Alright, I got it. I get it...
entries.JA_new: 分かった。了解です……

entries.EN: Be good!
entries.JA_current: Be good!
entries.JA_new: 達者でな！

entries.EN: Hel-l-lp.... Pl-lease...
entries.JA_current: Hel-l-lp.... Pl-lease...
entries.JA_new: た、助けて……お願い……

entries.EN: How you feeling, buddy?
entries.JA_current: How you feeling, buddy?
entries.JA_new: 具合はどうだ？

entries.EN: Bad... very bad... Medkit... now... You got one?..
entries.JA_current: Bad... very bad... Medkit... now... You got one?..
entries.JA_new: 最悪だ……ひどい……救急キットを……今すぐ……持ってるか？

entries.EN: Sure. Here you are.
entries.JA_current: Sure. Here you are.
entries.JA_new: ああ、これを使え。

entries.EN: None. I've run out of them.
entries.JA_current: None. I've run out of them.
entries.JA_new: ない。使い切った。

entries.EN: Nope. I lack it myself.
entries.JA_current: Nope. I lack it myself.
entries.JA_new: 悪いが、俺も持ってない。

entries.EN: God bless you! Thank you very much.
entries.JA_current: God bless you! Thank you very much.
entries.JA_new: 神のご加護を！　本当にありがとう。

entries.EN: Too bad. I'm dying... I don't have long...
entries.JA_current: Too bad. I'm dying... I don't have long...
entries.JA_new: だめだ……もう長くない……

entries.EN: Who are you?
entries.JA_current: Who are you?
entries.JA_new: あんたは誰だ？

entries.EN: I... I am a scientist. I arrived here with a squad of soldiers...
entries.JA_current: I... I am a scientist. I arrived here with a squad of soldiers...
entries.JA_new: わ、私は科学者です。兵士の分隊と一緒にここへ来ました……

entries.EN: Strange... Looks like your soldier friends shot you up real good. Why did they want to kill you?
entries.JA_current: Strange... Looks like your soldier friends shot you up real good. Why did they want to kill you?
entries.JA_new: 妙だな……兵士の仲間にひどく撃たれたようだ。なぜ殺そうとした？

entries.EN: Not only me in fact. There were several of us scientists in the expedition... I don't know why the soldiers decided to eliminate us, they were supposed to be our security detail.
entries.JA_current: Not only me in fact. There were several of us scientists in the expedition... I don't know why the soldiers decided to eliminate us, they were supposed to be our security detail.
entries.JA_new: 私だけではありません。遠征に参加した科学者は何人もいました……兵士たちは護衛のはずなのに、なぜ私たちを消そうとしたのか分かりません。

entries.EN: I've heard that the Military found something valuable down in the lab, is it true?
entries.JA_current: I've heard that the Military found something valuable down in the lab, is it true?
entries.JA_new: ミリタリーが研究所の奥で何か価値のあるものを見つけたと聞いた。本当か？

entries.EN: It's possible. I don't know anything for certain, though..
entries.JA_current: It's possible. I don't know anything for certain, though..
entries.JA_new: そうかもしれません。でも、確かなことは何も……

entries.EN: Too bad. I wish I knew what to look for. You keep safe now!
entries.JA_current: Too bad. I wish I knew what to look for. You keep safe now!
entries.JA_new: 残念だ。何を探せばいいか分かればよかったんだが。気をつけてな！

entries.EN: Since you had something to do with that expedition team, do you know anything about the combination lock down in the lab? Maybe you overheard something?
entries.JA_current: Since you had something to do with that expedition team, do you know anything about the combination lock down in the lab? Maybe you overheard something?
entries.JA_new: 遠征部隊の一員だったなら、研究所の暗証番号式の扉について何か知らないか？　何か聞いていないか？

entries.EN: Is the door locked? I know teams of soldiers went down there.
entries.JA_current: Is the door locked? I know teams of soldiers went down there.
entries.JA_new: 扉に鍵がかかってるのか？　兵士の部隊が降りていったのは知っている。

entries.EN: Yes, they went down and closed the door on purpose, I suppose.
entries.JA_current: Yes, they went down and closed the door on purpose, I suppose.
entries.JA_new: そうです。彼らは地下へ降りて、わざと扉を閉めたようです。

entries.EN: Sorry, but I don't know the combination. No one mentioned anything to us about the code.
entries.JA_current: Sorry, but I don't know the combination. No one mentioned anything to us about the code.
entries.JA_new: 申し訳ありませんが、番号は知りません。誰も暗証番号について話していませんでした。

entries.EN: Damn! That's what I was afraid of. I bet some of the army boys over there knew the code, but they got shot up real bad, none left alive...
entries.JA_current: Damn! That's what I was afraid of. I bet some of the army boys over there knew the code, but they got shot up real bad, none left alive...
entries.JA_new: くそっ、やっぱりか。向こうにいた兵士の誰かは番号を知ってたんだろうが、全員ひどく撃たれて死んでる……

entries.EN: Somebody killed them?! You mean, it wasn't mutants?! How can you be sure, I doubt anyone would be foolish enough to go up against the soldiers, our expedition was well equipped!
entries.JA_current: Somebody killed them?! You mean, it wasn't mutants?! How can you be sure, I doubt anyone would be foolish enough to go up against the soldiers, our expedition was well equipped!
entries.JA_new: 誰かが殺したんですか？！　ミュータントじゃなかったと？　どうして分かるんです？　装備の整った遠征部隊の兵士に立ち向かうほど、無謀な人間がいるとは思えません！

entries.EN: Well, let me put it this way. I found spent rifle cartridges scattered all over the place, and the bodies were torn up and deformed as if shot with high caliber rifle fire... No mutant claws or teeth can do damage like that, I can assure you of that.
entries.JA_current: Well, let me put it this way. I found spent rifle cartridges scattered all over the place, and the bodies were torn up and deformed as if shot with high caliber rifle fire... No mutant claws or teeth can do damage like that, I can assure you of that.
entries.JA_new: こう言えば分かるかな。使い終わったライフルの薬莢が、あちこちに散らばっていた。遺体は大口径の銃で撃たれたように、ずたずたに変形していた……ミュータントの爪や牙じゃ、あんな傷はつけられない。断言できる。

entries.EN: I see. Have you seen anybody else around here? Anyone lurking about? Maybe whoever shot up the military could still be around or they left traces...
entries.JA_current: I see. Have you seen anybody else around here? Anyone lurking about? Maybe whoever shot up the military could still be around or they left traces...
entries.JA_new: そうか。他に誰か見かけなかったか？　潜んでいる奴はいないか？　ミリタリーを撃った犯人がまだ近くにいるかもしれない。何か痕跡を残している可能性もある……

entries.EN: No, place is dead silent, no one around. Hmm.. I suppose I'll take a look around for anything left behind. Be back later!
entries.JA_current: No, place is dead silent, no one around. Hmm.. I suppose I'll take a look around for anything left behind. Be back later!
entries.JA_new: いや、辺りは静まり返っていて誰もいない。うーん、残された物がないか調べてみるよ。また後でな！

entries.EN: Check this thing out. I've found it by the entrance to the lab.
entries.JA_current: Check this thing out. I've found it by the entrance to the lab.
entries.JA_new: これを見てくれ。研究所の入口で見つけた。

entries.EN: So what? It's just a knife.
entries.JA_current: So what? It's just a knife.
entries.JA_new: それがどうした？　ただのナイフだろ。

entries.EN: Take a look at the engraving on the handle.
entries.JA_current: Take a look at the engraving on the handle.
entries.JA_new: 柄の刻印を見てくれ。

entries.EN: "Serega the Maniac". Are you going to look for him?
entries.JA_current: "Serega the Maniac". Are you going to look for him?
entries.JA_new: 「マニアックのセレガ」か。そいつを捜すのか？

entries.EN: Heh, looking for a single Stalker in the Zone can be like searching for a needle in a haystack, except the stack is on fire and riddled with anomalies, and there's people shooting at you while you're doing it. Here's hoping he hasn't gotten too far, or worse, gotten himself clipped. I think the local southern farm is a good place to start looking.
entries.JA_current: Heh, looking for a single Stalker in the Zone can be like searching for a needle in a haystack, except the stack is on fire and riddled with anomalies, and there's people shooting at you while you're doing it. Here's hoping he hasn't gotten too far, or worse, gotten himself clipped. I think the local southern farm is a good place to start looking.
entries.JA_new: ははっ。ゾーンで一人のストーカーを捜すなんて、干し草の山から針を探すようなものだ。しかも山は燃えていて、アノマリーだらけ。探してる間も誰かに撃たれる。遠くへ行っていないといいが……それどころか、死んでなきゃいいな。まずは南にある地元の農場から捜すのがよさそうだ。

entries.EN: Hey! Listen, I've been down in the lab and look what I've found there.
entries.JA_current: Hey! Listen, I've been down in the lab and look what I've found there.
entries.JA_new: おい！　聞いてくれ。研究所の地下へ行って、これを見つけた。

entries.EN: What's that? Looks like some research data inside... bio-hazard warnings... sample specimens... mentions of infectivity... There's a "Do Not Open" sign, but the container seal is...
entries.JA_current: What's that? Looks like some research data inside... bio-hazard warnings... sample specimens... mentions of infectivity... There's a "Do Not Open" sign, but the container seal is...
entries.JA_new: 何だ？　研究データみたいだな……バイオハザードの警告……サンプル……感染性についても書いてある……「開封厳禁」とあるが、ケースの封印は……

entries.EN: It's just the way I've found it.
entries.JA_current: It's just the way I've found it.
entries.JA_new: 見つけた時からこの状態だった。

entries.EN: What I mean is that you could have gotten infected with something, these documents suggest the contents of the container may have posed a significant bio-hazard. Would you permit me to carry out a blood test? Roll up your sleeve for me to take a blood sample for analysis.
entries.JA_current: What I mean is that you could have gotten infected with something, these documents suggest the contents of the container may have posed a significant bio-hazard. Would you permit me to carry out a blood test? Roll up your sleeve for me to take a blood sample for analysis.
entries.JA_new: つまり、何かに感染した可能性がある。書類によれば、ケースの中身は深刻な生物学的危険を伴っていたようだ。血液検査をさせてもらえないか？　袖をまくってくれ。分析用の血液を採る。

entries.EN: Yeah, sure, here you are.
entries.JA_current: Yeah, sure, here you are.
entries.JA_new: ああ、もちろん。ほら。

entries.EN:
Alright, let me just run a quick test... 
 
... 
 
Okay, data's coming in... Oh dear... No matches, interesting... Damn... Look, I've got some bad news. There's some type of unidentified virus present in your blood. The system can't isolate an exact structure and origin for some reason but it is breeding at an exponential rate.

entries.JA_new:
よし、すぐ検査してみる……
 
……
 
データが出てきた……ああ……一致するものがない。妙だな……くそっ……悪い知らせだ。君の血液に、正体不明のウイルスがいる。どういうわけか構造も起源も特定できないが、指数関数的な速度で増殖している。

entries.EN: Fuck, do you know what it does or if it can harm me?
entries.JA_current: Fuck, do you know what it does or if it can harm me?
entries.JA_new: くそっ、どんな影響があるか分かるのか？　俺に害はあるのか？

entries.EN: I don't know, hard to say without having the virus identified. These documents don't explain much either, it's just raw statistical data. It's strange though, this system can accurately identify all known viruses, pathogens, bacteria, you name it, yet it came back as a no hit. Never seen that before, it must mean the virus has been designed from scratch and is not yet on any known database. Considering that you found this case in a clandestine subterranean lab in the Zone, let's be realistic, it's safe to assume this probably isn't some miracle cure that boosts fertility! Who knows, could be a bio-weapon of some sort for all we know. I'd advise you to do something about it, and FAST!

entries.JA_new: 分からない。ウイルスを特定できないと何とも言えない。この書類にも詳しいことはなく、統計データだけだ。妙なのは、この検査機器なら既知のウイルスも病原体も細菌も、何でも正確に特定できる。それなのに、今回は何も検出されなかった。こんなのは初めてだ。まだデータベースにない、ゼロから設計されたウイルスということだろう。ゾーンの秘密地下研究所でケースを見つけたことを考えれば、現実的に見て、妊娠率を上げる奇跡の薬なんかじゃないだろう！　生物兵器かもしれない。とにかく、すぐに何か手を打つべきだ！

entries.EN: Do what? What is "something"!?
entries.JA_current: Do what? What is "something"!?
entries.JA_new: 何をすればいい？　「何か」って何だ？！
